results.title: Probability spaces and monotone events
results.label: p01-01
results.scope_contract: 概率空间、随机变量与随机元素、事件指示函数、概率的单调连续性和并集界

results.title: Laws, projections, and transfer of integrals
results.label: p01-02
results.scope_contract: 定律、推前复合和积分转移。非负及可积两版，联合分布与边缘投影

results.title: Determining classes and distribution functions
results.label: p01-03
results.scope_contract: π–λ／单调类唯一性在联合律的应用，实 CDF 的存在唯一性、多维联合 CDF 决定律

results.title: Tail integrals and probability bounds
results.label: p01-04
results.scope_contract: 尾积分和截断矩、Markov、Chebyshev、指数 Markov

results.title: Uniform integrability and the Vitali criterion
results.label: p01-05
results.scope_contract: 一致可积的有限测度判据和 Vitali，依概率收敛与 \(L^1\) 收敛的精确关系

results.title: Integral convergence and completion
results.label: p01-06
results.scope_contract: 非负／可积积分的收敛工具及完备化版本

results.title: Independence, generators, and joint laws
results.label: p02-01
results.scope_contract: σ-代数／随机元素族的相互独立，生成 π 系统判据，联合律与有限乘积律等价

results.title: Independent constructions, grouping, and integrals
results.label: p02-02
results.scope_contract: 可测变换、互不相交分组保独立，独立积分和乘积期望分解

results.title: The Borel--Cantelli lemmas
results.label: p02-03
results.scope_contract: 第一、第二 Borel–Cantelli。第二条保留两两独立的经典加强

results.title: Almost sure, probability, and moment convergence
results.label: p02-04
results.scope_contract: 几乎处处、依概率、\(L^p\) 收敛的关系及子列刻画

results.title: Kolmogorov and Hewitt--Savage zero--one laws
results.label: p02-05
results.scope_contract: Kolmogorov 尾 σ-代数零一律；i.i.d. 序列的 Hewitt–Savage 零一律

results.title: Existence and uniqueness
results.label: p03-01
results.scope_contract: 任意子 σ-代数下实值 \(L^1\) 条件期望的存在与 a.e. 唯一性；非负扩展版

results.title: Linearity, the tower law, and measurable factors
results.label: p03-02
results.scope_contract: 线性、正性、单调性、固定点、塔式法则与取出可测因子

results.title: Conditional Jensen and contraction
results.label: p03-03
results.scope_contract: 条件 Jensen、绝对值控制和 \(L^p\) 收缩

results.title: Conditional limits, variance, and uniform integrability
results.label: p03-04
results.scope_contract: 条件单调／支配收敛、条件方差与全方差公式、固定 \(L^1\) 变量的条件期望族 UI

results.title: Standard Borel coding and measurable factorization
results.label: p04-01
results.scope_contract: 标准 Borel 编码与 Doob–Dynkin；原 σ(X) 与完备化上的版本

results.title: Kernel integration and composition
results.label: p04-02
results.scope_contract: 概率核、核积分的可测性、半直积与复合、单位核与结合律

results.title: Existence of regular conditional laws
results.label: p04-03
results.scope_contract: 给定任意可测第一坐标与标准 Borel 第二坐标的概率联合律，存在正则条件律。覆盖随机变量仅 a.e. 可测的联合律版本及对任意子 σ-代数的条件分布

results.title: Uniqueness, conditional independence, and gluing
results.label: p04-04
results.scope_contract: 正则条件律的同一零测集唯一性，条件积分公式，条件独立的乘积分解与抽样后拼接

results.title: Measurable randomization and transfer
results.label: p04-05
results.scope_contract: 分位数实现、核的可测随机化与转移

results.title: The Ionescu--Tulcea extension
results.label: p05-01
results.scope_contract: Ionescu–Tulcea。任意可测值域的初始律和给定转移核产生唯一可数路径律

results.title: Consistent finite-dimensional laws
results.label: p05-02
results.scope_contract: 一致有限维边缘和 Kolmogorov 扩张。任意指标集、各坐标标准 Borel，乘积 σ-代数上存在且唯一

results.title: Independent products and the cylinder sigma-algebra
results.label: p05-03
results.scope_contract: 任意指标集的独立乘积实现；有限维分布决定圆柱律

results.title: Increment moments and continuous modifications
results.label: p05-04
results.scope_contract: 一维紧时间区间上 Kolmogorov–Chentsov。完备可分度量值域，增量 \(p\) 阶矩界 \(C\lvert t-s\rvert^{1+\beta}\) 给出任意指数 \(0<\gamma<\beta/p\) 的 Hölder 修改

results.title: Borel laws of continuous paths
results.label: p05-05
results.scope_contract: 连续路径的 Borel σ-代数由稠密可数取值生成，连续路径律由有限维分布确定。区分修改和不可分辨

results.title: Borel laws and determining tests
results.label: p06-01
results.scope_contract: 有界连续测试函数决定概率律；度量空间上开／闭集逼近与连续集

results.title: Portmanteau and determining classes
results.label: p06-02
results.scope_contract: Portmanteau。弱收敛、闭集上界、开集下界、连续集收敛及半连续测试；实 CDF 连续点判据

results.title: Continuous and varying maps
results.label: p06-03
results.scope_contract: Borel 拓扑空间上的固定连续映射定理；度量空间上的 a.s. 连续映射和可变映射定理
results.textbook_locations: 固定连续映射用 P01.02；度量空间版本见 B 2.7 p. 21、K 5.27–5.28 pp. 117–118

results.title: Perturbations, Slutsky, and moments
results.label: p06-04
results.scope_contract: 同一空间中的概率扰动、Slutsky、converging together。弱收敛配合 UI 得期望／矩收敛

results.title: Tightness and the forward Prokhorov theorem
results.label: p06-05
results.scope_contract: 单个律紧性、族的一致紧性。任意度量空间上的 Prokhorov 正向及紧序列的共同子列

results.title: The reverse Prokhorov theorem
results.label: p06-06
results.scope_contract: 可分完备度量下 Prokhorov 逆向。相对序列弱紧性蕴含一致紧性，度量化后与相对弱紧等价

results.title: The Skorokhod representation
results.label: p06-07
results.scope_contract: Skorokhod 表示。度量空间内极限律集中于可分 Borel 子集即可，保留 Polish 常用推论

results.title: Weak convergence and products
results.label: p06-08
results.scope_contract: 有限乘积律和可分度量值域的可数乘积。乘积拓扑下的弱收敛等价于有限维分布弱收敛

results.title: The Prokhorov and bounded Lipschitz metrics
results.label: p06-09
results.scope_contract: Prokhorov 度量与有界 Lipschitz 度量。可分时均刻画弱收敛
results.textbook_locations: B §6(iii)–(iv) p. 72；有界 Lipschitz 为连续测试的补充证明

results.title: Couplings and completeness of the law space
results.label: p06-10
results.scope_contract: Strassen–Dudley 耦合与 Polish 概率律空间的可分、完备性

results.title: Tightness on continuous path space
results.label: p06-11
results.scope_contract: \(C([0,T],\mathbb R^d)\) 中初值紧性与模连续性判据，以及紧性加有限维收敛推出弱收敛

results.title: Characteristic functions and moments
results.label: p07-01
results.scope_contract: 特征函数归一、连续、正定与共轭对称；卷积和独立和；有限矩下微分与二阶展开

results.title: Inversion and uniqueness
results.label: p07-02
results.scope_contract: 特征函数唯一性、实轴区间反演的端点半质量、可积特征函数的连续有界密度

results.title: The continuity theorem
results.label: p07-03
results.scope_contract: Lévy 连续性。逐点极限在零点连续时恢复唯一概率律，并有弱收敛

results.title: Projections and Gaussian vectors
results.label: p07-04
results.scope_contract: Cramér–Wold，允许退化的有限维高斯律和边缘／线性映射判据

results.title: Positive definite functions
results.label: p07-05
results.scope_contract: Euclidean Bochner 的归一化版本。连续正定且 \(\phi(0)=1\) 时得到唯一概率律

results.title: From Gaussian marginals to Wiener measure
results.label: p07-06
results.scope_contract: 从一致高斯边缘到 Wiener 律的一次完整接口验证

results.title: Weak laws and truncation
results.label: p08-01
results.scope_contract: 不相关变量的方差弱律，i.i.d. 的截断弱律及 \(L^1\) 弱律。弱尾假设 \(nP(\lvert X\rvert>n)\to0\) 时围绕截断均值收敛

results.title: The first-moment strong law
results.label: p08-02
results.scope_contract: Etemadi 强大数定律。两两独立、同分布、\(\mathbb E\lvert X\rvert<\infty\)；i.i.d. 平均有有限 a.s. 极限蕴含一阶绝对矩有限

results.title: Maximal inequality and variance summability
results.label: p08-03
results.scope_contract: Kolmogorov 最大不等式，独立中心化平方可积级数的 a.s. 与 \(L^2\) 收敛

results.title: Kronecker's lemma and weighted strong laws
results.label: p08-04
results.scope_contract: Kronecker 引理和 Kolmogorov 方差判据强律

results.title: Kolmogorov's three-series theorem
results.label: p08-05
results.scope_contract: Kolmogorov 三系定理，独立实变量级数的充要条件

results.title: Marcinkiewicz--Zygmund strong laws
results.label: p08-06
results.scope_contract: Marcinkiewicz–Zygmund 强律，i.i.d. 实变量 \(0<p<2\)。一阶以上保留中心化，一阶以下给未中心化版本

results.title: The empirical distribution function
results.label: p08-07
results.scope_contract: 实变量 Glivenko–Cantelli。所有分布函数，包括带原子情形

results.title: The independent identically distributed central limit theorem
results.label: p09-01
results.scope_contract: i.i.d. 有限方差标量 CLT，含零方差；有限维版本允许奇异协方差

results.title: Lindeberg's condition for independent rows
results.label: p09-02
results.scope_contract: Lindeberg–Feller 正向，独立三角阵列、行内中心化、有限行总方差 \(s_n^2>0\)，归一化后 Lindeberg 成立

results.title: The Feller converse and the Lyapunov criterion
results.label: p09-03
results.scope_contract: Feller 逆向和 Lyapunov 充分条件

results.title: The Poisson limit for independent rare events
results.label: p09-04
results.scope_contract: 独立 Bernoulli 稀有事件 Poisson 极限，\(\max_j p_{nj}\to0\)、\(\sum_j p_{nj}\to\lambda\ge0\)

results.title: Berry--Esseen and smoothing
results.label: p09-05
results.scope_contract: 经典 i.i.d. Berry–Esseen。正方差及有限三阶绝对中心矩，给出普适常数与 \(n^{-1/2}\) 的 Kolmogorov 距离界
